crossRefs.note: Where could I go from your Spirit? Or where could I flee from your presence?
in which I suffer hardship to the point of chains as a criminal. But God’s word isn’t chained.

people.name: Jeremiah
people.line: Son of Hilkiah, the prophet during Judah's final days.

people.name: Tahpanhes
people.line: Egyptian city where Jewish refugees fled after Jerusalem's destruction

translations.web: Then Yahweh’s word came to Jeremiah in Tahpanhes, saying,
translations.bsb: Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah at Tahpanhes:
translations.kjv: Then came the word of the LORD unto Jeremiah in Tahpanhes, saying,
translations.asv: Then came the word of Jehovah unto Jeremiah in Tahpanhes, saying,
